                    AND post_id != {$post['post_id']}

            if(empty($have))
            {
                @unlink(BB_ROOT . $bb_cfg['imgs']['upload_path'] '/' . $post['poster_id'] . end(explode('/', $match[1])));
            }
        }
    }
}
